data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Fundanus was a god who presided over hidden or secret knowledge. In Christianity, Funda is a name for a strong and deep-thinking woman. The name Funda carries the meaning “Deep, hidden knowledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Funda usually hope their child will grow to embody deep, hidden knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
